data.gender_notes: Rajindar is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rajindar is recorded with the meaning “Ruler of Kings”. Rajindar is a Hindu name meaning “Ruler of Kings”. in_sanskrit.name: राजिन्दर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who rules over Indra, the god of rain and thunder, and thus, the giver of rain and prosperity.

in_hindi.name: राजिन्दर
in_hindi.meaning: राजा का दास, राजा का दर्द
in_hindi.long_meaning: Slave or beloved of the king, or the pain of the king.

in_tamil.name: ராஜிந்தர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has a great desire for the kingdom or one who possesses royalty and power.

in_telugu.name: రాజిన్దర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who rules or one who is a symbol of royalty.

in_marathi.name: Rajindar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Kings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajindar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over kings and kingdoms, a powerful and wise ruler, a king who is a wise leader.

in_bengali.name: Rajindar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ruler of Kings
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rajindar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules over kings and kingdoms, a powerful and wise ruler, a king who is a wise leader.
